method: Unchanged engine jump, actual native controller/phase driver, real fitted Tripo katana; referenced weapon surface vertices at four rendered subdivisions per 60Hz simulation step (240Hz), including frame zero, takeoff and 15 grounded recovery ticks after landing. Image decoding alone is bypassed. Flat default arena; takeoff at simulation tick 1, four boost-input timings recorded in inputBoostTick and actual boost observation, plus the plain unboosted jump; no source/body offset invented.
